nodes.label: README.md
nodes.author: JavierC
nodes.rationale: Designed to reduce installation friction: highly automated default flow, firmware-type detection, and optional manual partitioning; modular architecture separates backend logic from the GTK frontend for easy expansion and distribution adaptability via Universal Mode.

nodes.label: .forgejo/workflows/build.yml (CI build workflow)
nodes.rationale: Uses a Void Linux container with privileged access to /dev for disk-oriented builds; installs Node and the toolchain through pure shell first to avoid Node-based action dependencies; produces a tarball of the neko_installer binary.

nodes.label: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.rationale: Project is in an organizational phase: priority is documentation, structure and reporting rather than code optimization; bugs should be reported, not fixed, and AI should not modify code unnecessarily because undocumented changes can break already-undocumented parts; stability outweighs optimization.

nodes.label: neko_installer_universal executable (distro-agnostic build)
nodes.rationale: Universal build drops Void-specific xbps dependencies for broad distribution compatibility.
